subject: English
passage: Established in 1993, the W. M. Keck Observatory in Hawaii is dedicated to optical and infrared astronomy using its twin 10-meter telescopes. More recently constructed observatories devoted to space research include the Vera C. Rubin Observatory. Located in Chile's Atacama Desert, it focuses on survey astronomy and tracking near-Earth objects.
prompt: Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?

choices.A: To trace a historical development that encouraged the founding of two observatories.
choices.B: To trace the founding of two observatories, including how they acquired funding to purchase equipment.
choices.C: To present information about two observatories, including each observatory's area of focus.
choices.D: To draw a contrast between the collection sizes of two observatories.

explanation: Choice C is the best answer because it most accurately describes the main purpose of the text. The passage presents factual information about two observatories and describes what each one focuses on. The text introduces the Keck Observatory (founded 1993, in Hawaii, dedicated to optical and infrared astronomy, with twin 10-meter telescopes) and then describes the Vera C. Rubin Observatory (located in Chile's Atacama Desert, focused on survey astronomy and tracking near-Earth objects). Both institutions are described in terms of their locations and research specializations—their 'areas of focus.'
